name: Permaculture Plants SC
description: Permaculture Plants SC promotes sustainable agriculture through permaculture practices, providing communities with knowledge and resources for self-sufficient gardening.
contentSubHeading: Explore our sustainable practices and community initiatives

branchFeatures.description: We design perennial food systems that feed families for decades — trees, shrubs, and ground covers working together the way nature intended.
Our workshops and field days pass on the skills and patterns of permaculture so every household can grow its own abundance without depending on industrial supply chains.
Compacted, depleted earth becomes rich living ground when we stop tilling and start building. Our practices reverse damage and awaken the biological communities beneath our feet.
We steward an open-pollinated seed library so that the varieties suited to our climate stay in local hands — resilient genetics for a resilient community.
